results.criterion: 涵蓋受益者／價值、範圍、可觀察AC、失敗邊界、依賴、來源、未知、第一步與授權。
results.reason: Shared contract and actual S1 three drafts preserve outcome, scope, observable success/failure, sources, unknowns, dependencies, next step and authority.

results.criterion: Story切分依獨立成果與依賴／交付界線，無四層空殼或每步一Issue。
results.reason: Actual S1 plan uses four explicitly independent outcomes, keeps success/failure in one Story and identifies conditional delivery dependencies; no hierarchy shells/per-verb Issues.

results.criterion: 功能、技術、研究三例與模糊過大反例，不捏造要求或上線結果。
results.reason: Four source fictional examples cover functional, business, technical and research outcomes; vague overlarge counterexample explains slicing. S1 executes functional/technical drafts and bounded research planning without fabricated execution.

results.criterion: 新agent只讀產物即可接手；不靠作者補充。
results.reason: Fresh S3 consumed exact actual S1 subsection only and reconstructed source/status/unknown/authority before a separately authorized design operation.

results.criterion: 所選A/B路徑沒有重複owner；既有能力回歸與真實安裝／actor證據分開。
results.reason: Owner boundaries independently reviewed; current default243 passes; two actual standalone/combined installs and S3 distinguish actual evidence from unchanged historical test-designer A2 baseline.

results.criterion: 可以只 review 指定的一個 AC；只回報該範圍的問題、依據、影響與建議，不自行重寫其他 Story 內容或宣稱產品驗收通過。
results.reason: S2 reports only AC-2 findings with source, consequence and bounded suggestions; whole-Story review is separate and no edits or acceptance claim applied.

results.criterion: 三套範本各有符合目的的輸出，且 Azure DevOps Description 與 AC 內容可分別使用；來源、已接受決策及未知不遺失。
results.reason: S1 produces three distinct Description forms with separate AC fields and source/status/unknown handoff context.

results.criterion: 既有 GWT、非 Gherkin 技術條件與 caller-selected 模板皆能保留；不複製 test-designer 的測試設計責任。
results.reason: S2 preserves custom Goal/Rules/Open, exact approved GWT and pending prose; S1 preserves non-Gherkin technical criteria; actual test design belongs to test-designer in S3.

limits: Local source completion only; no hosted CI, provider closure, release, native Claude runtime or real-project adoption. S3 ordering limitation preserved in actor-verification.
